name: 프레임 보간 탐지
description: Identifies artificially interpolated frames in video that indicate AI-generated content.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated video with artificially smooth or interpolated motion
mechanism: Analyzes inter-frame motion patterns in the frequency domain to detect artificially interpolated frames. AI video generators often produce unnaturally smooth motion by inserting generated intermediate frames, which creates detectable spectral artifacts.
source: Stamm & Liu (2009) - Forensic Detection of Image Manipulation Using Statistical Intrinsic Fingerprints, IEEE TIP
algorithm: Spectral Analysis + Inter-frame DCT + Motion Vector Consistency
parameters: Frame pairs: consecutive, DCT block size: 8x8, Motion threshold: adaptive, Frequency bands: low/mid/high
strengths:
• Effective at detecting AI-generated smooth video
• Works in frequency domain for robust detection
• Can identify specific interpolated frame ranges
• Low false positive rate on natural video
limitations:
• May miss high-quality interpolation
• Sensitive to video encoding settings
• Less effective on very short clips
• Natural slow-motion can trigger false positives

references.title: Stamm, M. & Liu, K. (2009). Forensic Detection of Image Manipulation Using Statistical Intrinsic Fingerprints. IEEE TIP.
Wu, Y. et al. (2022). Detecting Video Frame Rate Up-Conversion Based on Frame-Level Analysis. IEEE TIFS.
Bian, S. et al. (2020). Detecting Frame Deletion in H.264 Video. IEEE Access.
